findings: Identity/proportions: Neet has broad triangular ears, projecting cream muzzle, fine long legs, full narrow fawn torso and a tiny visible rump nub. Buddy has a continuous moderately long charcoal torso, visible neck/deep chest and substantial legs with clearance; neither has an enlarged puppy skull.

Anatomy/support/limb ownership: Buddy has two distinct rear supports, one planted forepaw and the other forepaw resting on the blanket with a continuous shoulder-to-paw path. Neet has four separately readable grounded supports. Floor contact shadows support both dogs; the blanket does not become a limb.

Grooming/finish: both trunks use smooth broad painted values with close contours, not engraved curls or raised shag. Buddy retains irregular projecting pale moustache, small beard, brow arcs and hanging ear furnishings; regional distal leg edges are short and restrained. His low dark tail tapers with a modest tip fringe.

Perspective/scene/setting: shared floor plane, blanket depth and shrine furniture are coherent. The murti remains on its flower-decorated home shrine before departure, as required at this anchor. No new human likeness is asserted.

Comedy: Buddy claims the blanket with a paw and looks pleadingly toward upright serious Neet, making the roommate proposal legible without replacing the devotional context. The image occurs before the pillow rebuttal.

Identity/proportions: rear three-quarter seated Neet retains broad ears, projecting profile muzzle, a full narrow upper torso and an explicit tiny nub. Buddy retains elongated seated trunk, neck and modest projecting head; the overlapping sit is not an excuse for disconnected anatomy.

Anatomy/support/limb ownership: each seated rump meets the bank; folded haunches belong to their own body, and visible front supports terminate at grounded paws. Far limbs are plausibly occluded by the seated body rather than visibly duplicated. Neither dog floats above the bank.

Grooming/tail/finish: smooth charcoal and fawn torso fields do not reproduce the staging pencil curls. Buddy has a dark low tail that narrows away from the rump to a pointed end; the short pale lower fringe does not form a plume or ring. This replacement passes the requested tail scrutiny. Furnishings remain localized to muzzle, brows, pendant ears and limited distal-leg edges.

Perspective/scene/setting: foreground dogs and shoreline rocks establish scale against the lake, distant families and boats. The murti is visibly partly immersed among petals rather than resting on a dry raft. Wind-borne marigold petals supply the exact farewell state.

Comedy/emotion: the paired solemn sentries and their fixed attention provide continuity from the escort; the wider quiet composition honors the devotional farewell rather than forcing an extra gag. It complements the indoor blanket setup.

Identity/proportions: Buddy retains continuous elongated torso and neck, substantial legs, pale furnished muzzle, modest beard/brows and softly hanging ears. Neet has a full narrow resting trunk, broad triangular ears, projecting muzzle and fine extended forelegs; rear anatomy is folded beneath the rump with a small nub.

Anatomy/support/limb ownership: all four Buddy paws have leg paths and separate floor/rug contacts. His lowered head reaches the toy on the shrine shelf without neck disconnection. Neet has two distinct forepaws, supported breast/belly and connected folded hindquarter; no stray limb crosses from Buddy.

Grooming/finish: broad smooth body planes replace engraved or curly trunk texture. Short subtle shoulder marks do not project fur volume. Buddy has irregular muzzle strands, small chin beard and regional ear/paw furnishings; distal leg contour marks remain short. Tail is predominantly dark, tapering and lightly fringed, not a plume.

Perspective/scene/setting: shelf, rug and floor contacts read coherently. Empty shrine, single diya, garland and deposited squeaky bone preserve the post-immersion state. Buddy is still standing at the toy before the following sentence says he settles beside Neet.

Comedy/emotion: the earlier blanket hospitality becomes a quiet toy offering. The image preserves the earned devotional ending without a punchline. Neet is depicted in relaxed sternal rest with tucked hindquarters rather than a tight curl; this does not change the resting action or subsequent settling beat.
